notes: REF-BM-02: no remote page fetch; title defaults to URL, no description/preview collection; favicon is only guessed client-side from hostname via Google service, not collected from the page. REF-BM-03: title/description are freely editable before and after saving, but there is no auto-collection to edit. REF-BM-04: url/title/description/tags editable via PUT, but there is no note field. REF-BM-06: POST always inserts a new row; no duplicate-url detection or convergence to editing. REF-BM-10: tags input is a plain text field with no datalist/autocomplete of existing tags. REF-BM-12: search covers title/description/url/tags but note is not a field, so note search is absent. REF-BM-14: q is matched with plain LIKE across columns; no `#tag` parsing, and stored tags lack the '#', so `#tag` syntax does not work. REF-BM-15: no boolean AND/OR/NOT or parenthesis parsing. REF-BM-16: no quoted-phrase exact-match parsing. REF-BM-17/18/19: no unread flag, view, or read/unread toggle (only a favorite flag exists). REF-BM-20/21: no multi-select or bulk actions. REF-BM-22: list has a fixed ORDER BY (favorite, then date added); no user-selectable sort key. REF-BM-23: no markdown note field or rendering. REF-BM-24/25: no snapshot/PDF or Internet Archive support. REF-BM-26/27/28: no archive flag, list, or reversible-archive distinction. REF-BM-29: no bundle/saved-filter entity. REF-BM-30/31: no Netscape HTML import/export. REF-BM-32: no user settings (sort/items/font size).
